training_dataset.provenance: Synthetic budget training v1: explicit ideal GNSS/perception/map availability; return-home corridors derived from vtol-diverse-routes synthetic template. Rotated route families partition splits; limited related synthetic families, not measured data or generalization proof. Airframe identity taken from owned u-run profile, no hardware authority.

evaluation_dataset.provenance: Derived synthetic stress holdout from task-sequence-heterogeneous-v1; family labels are disjoint from training, with changed snapshot IDs, wind and remaining-flight-time state. This is a software planning holdout, not physical or field-independent evidence.
